verdict.rationale: The pack contains no published statutory fee amounts for any HMRC transaction. The only exact figure is the £90,000 VAT registration threshold, which is a turnover trigger rather than a fee. Fee publication is a fair question for a government filing and registration service, so the verdict is none rather than na.
